author: opt-N10

contract.sync_assumed: all lanes of the hardware warp call the primitive together (the logical warps of a sub-warp instantiation run in lockstep)
contract.sync_performed: shuffles, ballots and one redux on the full warp mask, no barrier
contract.k_range: [1, N] with MaxK = max(LW, next_pow2(k)) dividing N and N / MaxK a power of two, the truncated merge applies to a power of two k (other k take the complete merge and a shuffle), k 4 to 64 measured
contract.n_range: N = LW x IPT with MaxK dividing N and N / MaxK a power of two, measured 32 to 256 at LW 32 and 8 to 128 at LW 4, 8, 16
contract.type_constraints: fp32 keys only, twiddled to an order-preserving u32 word (sign flip, -0.0 mapped to +0.0), the index is never carried through the network and is recovered from the item's position (slot i of lane l is source index i x LW + l) by ballot rank
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN twiddles above +inf (positive sign) or below -inf (negative sign) and is selected or dropped deterministically by its sign bit, never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 and +0.0 are one word
contract.tie_break_support: prefer_smaller_index exact by construction (items above the k-th word in index order, then the tied items in index order until k), the same code serves not_guaranteed at the same cost (within 0.04 percent in every measured pair of cells)
contract.sorted_output_support: not provided: the output is the selected set in class and index order (the complete-merge form N10_u32 has the sorted keys in position but places indices by rank, not by position)

correctness_notes: Batch 2 (umbriel-b200-020, one lease, seven consecutive run.py lock sections). Oracle battery (13 patterns, prefer_smaller_index checked exactly, including tie_heavy, pivot_tie, all_equal, signed_zero, inf_denorm) passed on every cell before any number. not_guaranteed and prefer_smaller_index are the same instantiation and measured within 0.04 percent of each other in every cell pair, the card lists both. Control N10_ge1_trunc_sub in the same lock section (section s7, prefer_smaller_index cells).

low_level: Sub-warp form: logical warps of 4, 8 and 16 lanes inside one hardware warp, shuffles with the full warp mask (the xor partner stays inside the segment), ballots on the full warp masked to the segment, the redux.min as one full-warp redux per logical warp with the identity in the other lanes (T37, T40) and the tie branch made uniform over the hardware warp with one any-vote. No BSSY from partial-mask collectives (the W1 sub-warp controls carry them). Level tile order with the truncated final merge. Registers as the eager form (79, 118, 168 in the latency kernel at N 128 for LW 16, 8, 4), one 32 byte stack frame with 11 STL at LW 4 N 128 k 4 (the only local memory in the N10 cells), throughput occupancy 4, 2, 1 blocks per SM at N 128.
algorithmic: Against the eager order with the same recovery (N10_ge1_trunc_sub, same lock section), prefer_smaller_index latency: N 8 and N 32 at LW 8 and 16 within 2 cycles (one or two tiles), LW 4 N 32 k 4, 8 734, 784 against 951, 840 (0.77x, 0.93x), k 16 844 against 832, LW 16 N 128 k 4 to 16 1160, 1158, 1133 against 1618, 1616, 1571 (0.72x), k 64 1299 against 1262, LW 8 N 128 k 4, 8, 16 1413, 1409, 1582 against 2237, 2233, 1758 (0.63x, 0.63x, 0.90x), k 64 1865 against 1847, LW 4 N 128 k 4, 8 1796, 2111 against 3110, 2531 (0.58x, 0.83x), k 16, 64 within 1 percent. Throughput plus 4 to 10 percent at N 128 (LW 8 N 128 k 8 501 against 457 Gelem per s), equal elsewhere.

Against the u64 word through the same-session control chain: LW 8 N 128 k 8 1409 against 5299 (0.27x) and against the pairs 4189 (0.34x), LW 16 N 128 k 16 1133 against 3469 (0.33x), LW 4 N 128 k 8 2111 against 8289 (0.25x).
negative: No gain at one or two tiles, and none at k 64 (MaxK 64, two tiles at N 128 for every LW). LW 4 N 32 k 4 and 8 stay behind the pairs network (734 and 784 against 610 and 612).
surprises: At LW 4 N 32 (two tiles of MaxK 16, M 4) the level order gains 23 percent at k 4 where the dependency graph is the same as the eager one, the phase 1 interleaving of the four in-register sorts is what the eager loop's schedule misses at a small logical warp.
open_questions: Whether the LW 4 N 128 register footprint (168, one block per SM) can be cut by recomputing the twiddled originals from the harness keys after the network instead of keeping both copies, which would matter for the batched router kernels.
